The '''monar serpent''' was a type of [[Snake/Legends|serpent]] that shed its scales. The serpent's scale shedding was similar to the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']] losing pieces of its [[Hull/Legends|hull]] as it descended through the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant's]] [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] during the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]]<ref name="MF" /> in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Monar serpents were mentioned in the [[2008]] book [[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']] by [[James Luceno]].<ref name="MF" />
